source: Fresh private Ubuntu 24.04 + nested GNOME 46 Mutter on Wayland, no Xwayland clients. Original signed-out ChatGPT plus system Debian Chromium in the same guest. No external network.
browserStartup: Cold launch by the registered XDG handler after the original app opened its callback
sourceAction: A physical X11 XTest left press and release on the nested GNOME seat, at the target calculated from the original app layout and compositor placement. The original ChatGPT button received Wayland native pointer input; system browser had no debugging endpoint.
browserCloseAction: Native X11 XTest Ctrl+W to the single nested Mutter seat; Mutter routed the key to the currently focused Wayland window.
graphicsMeasurement: This verifies the native window ownership, input and transition only. No browser graphics were captured.
chromiumCloudPackageNote: Temporary read-only Debian Chromium and nine runtime libraries in the Ubuntu test role.
